overviewHtml:
Langtang Valley Ganjala Pass Helambu Trek is full of wilderness adventure. You can trek the trail covered with snow and forest trails. The most diversified is probably in the whole Langtang Region. Nepal Unique Treks is proud to offer the package to aspiring trekkers. You can feel the forest environment and walk in the snow in this Langtang Trekking Package.

The journey begins as similar to the Langtang Valley Trek. The difference however is from the Kyanjin Gompa. Syaprubeshi to the Kyanjin is full of fun. The forest environment in the Lama Hotel and Ghoda Tabela will surprise you with the wood's fascination. Langtang Valley and Kyanjin Gompa offer the traditional Tibetan-influenced community culture and traditions.

Once you ascend towards Ganjala Pass from Kyanjin the journey becomes strenuous. Observing the spectacular view of the Langtang Lirung, Langtang Mountain, Sishapangma and other lofty Himalayan ranges the journey travels ahead. The pass is very daunting and resembles the semi-mountaineering during a few seasons. You are highly recommended to become extremely careful and be close with the trekking guides. Once you have passed the glorious yet challenging pass Helambu can be reached.

Langtang Valley Ganjala Pass Helambu Trek is termed as diversified because of these geographical settings. Observing the mystical forests and numerous water streams the trip heads to Melamchi Village. This is probably the most scenic village in the Langtang region. The trail falls under the Langtang National Park. There are high possibility to get encountering endangered species of animals, vegetation, and birds. It is believed that rare red pandas too can be found in the region. From Melamchi Bazaar the bus drive will take you back to Kathmandu.

Nepal Unique Treks ensures great hospitality and a hassle-free itinerary. Book the Langtang Valley Ganjala Pass Helambu Trek with an experienced team. We have been organizing trekking in Nepal at Langtang region for more than a decade. Experience diversified Nepal with us

Langtang Valley Ganjala Pass Helambu Trek - Outline Itinerary


Day 01: Arrival at the international airport in Kathmandu (1350m)

Day 02: sightseeing tour in Kathmandu Valley

Day 03: Kathmandu to Syabru Beshi

Day 04: Syabru bensi to Lama Hotel

Day 05: lama hotel to Langtang village

Day 06: Trek to Kyangjin Gompa

Day 07: Trek to Ngegang

Day 08: Trek to Ganja la pass

Day 09: Trek to Dukpa

Day 10: Trek towards the Tharkeghyang

Day 11: Exploration day at Tharkeghyang

Day 12: Trek to Sermathang

Day 13: Sermathang to Melamchi

Day 14: farewell and departure.
